facts.business: Brijlaxmi Leasing and Finance Limited is a non-banking finance company engaged in providing loans and advances.

auditor.name: Not stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) Loan & Advances balances subject to confirmation/reconciliation; 2) Non-compliance with Ind AS 19 Employee Benefits; 3) Interest income not recognized on outstanding loans and advances due to lack of documentation; 4) Trade Receivables, Trade Payables, Advance to Suppliers subject to confirmation/reconciliation; 5) Non-compliance with TDS provisions under Income Tax Act. Emphasis of Matter: Balances of Trade Receivables, Trade Payables, Advance to Suppliers subject to confirmation/reconciliation.
